_comment: The TALK leg of the 3-path mage-consult parity (cisterns_talk precedent -- persuade Pisces, zero combat anywhere). door_chain_talk_start stands the player beside Pisces with door_chain_started already banked (beat 1 is door_chain_fight's own live proof), and (Issue #50) [Diplomat] L1 already held so consult_talk_argue's close shows visible-unlocked at its Diplomat-gated free branch. Proves: the persuade chain (door_consult -> consult_talk_pitch -> consult_talk_argue) banks the SAME door_understood the FIGHT leg banks (3-path identity rule) via persuaded_someone + the internal pedestal_unsealed convergence counter, AND -- the important negative proof this script alone carries -- that pedestal_unsealed from a TALK-leg producer is enough to open anchor_stone_pedestal's contains_when gate WITHOUT ever fighting ruin_guardian (the OR-gate's non-FIGHT leg, proven live via a whole-run combat_started absence). Uses `teleport` for the inn->ruin hop (real navigation already proven by ruin_walkthrough/door_chain_fight). The 5-gold non-Diplomat alternate (added this same issue) stays untested-by-canonical here (crate_talk covers a paid-alternate branch instead).

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the door_chain_talk_start manual slot.
Visible greet options: [0 'teach me to cast', 1 'Never mind.', 2 'Something's come through our pantry door...'] -- move to index 2.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A door with opinions. How very like this city. Three ways to satisfy my curiosity: bleed for it, talk me into caring, or prove you can read a ward without my help. Choose, and don't waste my morning.

steps._comment: door_consult: index 1 is the TALK leg.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: You want me to walk into someone's pantry and grope at a wild ward with my bare senses. No. I have wards of my own I'd rather keep.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: ...A glance. Hm. If it truly reads as spatial and not necrotic, I could examine it without touching a thing. Fine, for the intellectual insult of not knowing, not for you.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A spatial anchor. Crude. Fascinating. Whoever built your inn, adventurer, built it on something that remembers being elsewhere.

steps._comment: == open the pedestal WITHOUT ever fighting ruin_guardian -- pedestal_unsealed already banked by the TALK leg above. ==
THE negative proof: zero combat happened anywhere in this whole run -- the TALK leg's consult knowledge alone opened the pedestal.
